notes.title: A Date with Death ZERO Webcomic Out Now!
notes.content:
The world turns endlessly. People live, people die, and the Grim Reapers of the Underworld ensure the cycle remains unbroken. Nameless and unseen, these Reapers ferry souls to their final rest. In the 13th station, a new Reaper is "born." Known only as 8394, he awakens with no memories, no past—just a scythe and a duty. As he’s thrust into the Underworld, he must confront what it truly means to carry the weight of death itself. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44167142/e3ecf1c2075378957a248fc63559cfa4674fd4bb.png

A Date with Death ZERO is our free prequel webcomic to A Date with Death that follow Casper in the years after his 'creation' as a Grim Reaper! If you've been wanting some more ADWD content after Beyond the Bet, this is a great stepping stone to future content ;)

Read it on Webtoon or Tapas!

notes.title: A Date with Death Beyond the Bet Announcement & Azrael Plushie Live!
notes.content:
New DLC Announcement

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44167142/8dbdedbb17c6a79850f828ed211f3e7b64f5c270.png

You've spent seven days alongside the Grim Reaper - you, an ordinary(?) person, and him, someone that shouldn't exist.

Throughout these seven days, you've laughed, you've cried, you've fallen in love... but so many mysteries still remain.

Who really is he, and how did he come to exist in the first place?

Delve deeper into the story of A Date with Death with a brand new route, starting with a new day 6 and leading all the way until day 10. New conversations, new art, and the same Grim Reaper you've come to love awaits you, all wrapped up in a mystery-solving, humorous, domestic package.

About
A Date with Death is a supernatural romance chat simulator visual novel about the week long bet you enter against the Grim Reaper to attempt to keep your soul. When complications arrive and your bet needs to be extended, you'll spend additional days chatting, calling and talking in person with the Grim Reaper himself.

Features
💀 Additional Content: Five brand new days of chatting and calling with your favorite babygirl reaper.
💀 Brand New Art: A host of brand new CGs from original game artist Fuyuure!
💀 New Endings: Two new endings that lead into your future (or not) with Grim.

You can wishlist it right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2799720/A_Date_with_Death__Beyond_the_Bet_DLC/

notes.title: A Date with Death is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Are you ready to face the Reaper?



A Date with Death, our free to play romance chatsim that features custom character creation, Discord-like chatting and a babygirl Grim Reaper is OUT NOW on Steam!

Make sure to tease our little Grim as much as possible, okay? ❤️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2415010/A_Date_with_Death/

You're just an ordinary person… or so you thought. For your entire life, you've been narrowly avoiding death by pure luck… or is it something more? When a strange program suddenly appears on your computer, and someone claiming to be the Grim Reaper says he's come for your soul, your life as you know it is thrown upside down.

As you delve deeper into the mysterious man that calls himself the Grim Reaper, you begin to wonder if fate brought you two together for a reason. Can you resist his charm, or will you fall for the one destined to take your soul?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44167142/057b233efe24a027f790f7b00c58677e3b428033.png

💀 Custom Character Creation: Build your own protagonist, from their physical appearance to their pronouns and name. Update them throughout the game!
💀 Room Design: Decorate your apartment to your liking and create a cozy space that you'll love coming back to.
💀 Pet Your Furry (or scaley?) Companion: Yes, you can pet the dog. Snuggle up with your furry friend and let their cute antics help you unwind.
💀 Choices That Matter: Make decisions that will affect your character's fate and lead you to one of multiple possible endings. What kind of relationship will you have with the Grim Reaper?
💀 Gorgeous Original Art: Lose yourself in stunning visuals that bring the story to life, and feel like you're truly part of the world of A Date with Death.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44167142/c193e19fe9cb694e349cd9b944a19c5de32b5743.gif

The expansion DLC for A Date with Death is a way to support the (free!) game's development and get a few extras.


 Extra character customization options (five hair fronts, five hair backs, three fem outfits + recolors, four masc outfits + recolors, and 13 accessories)
 Adds extra choices and conversations throughout all days (find the ★ symbol!)
 Adds one additional ending (including a new CG)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44167142/515bae85f082f801a2a71c31a1c646f4fe925f68.gif


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2696090/A_Date_with_Death__Expansion_DLC/
